Papyrus Moléculaire
Eau de Parfum

Uniqueness and adventure:
Papyrus Moléculaire is an artistic and rebellious creation, inspired by a fascinating encounter: tattooed women weaving papyrus leaves while puffing on cigarillos. This fragrance combines the milky, woody softness of papyrus with the smoky, deep intensity of tobacco - a harmonious yet contrasting composition full of character.

The fascinating duality:
The fragrance unfolds with spicy, fresh accents of coriander and black pepper, which create a lively opening. The heart is the characteristic papyrus oil, whose woody, milky note radiates a warm and powdery elegance. This is complemented by the intense depth of tobacco and a distinctive leather accord. The base, characterized by the sweetness of the tonka bean and the creamy warmth of sandalwood, gives the fragrance a sensual, long-lasting depth.

Fragrance family:
Woody Powdery Spicy – ​​a sophisticated blend of woody, powdery and spicy nuances that are both rebellious and elegant.

Main ingredients:

  • Coriander oil: Fresh, spicy and aromatic, for an invigorating start.
  • Papyrus oil: mild, woody and slightly powdery notes, the heart of the composition.
  • Sandalwood oil: Creamy and soft, with a soothing warmth.
  • Black pepper oil: Spicy and hot, for a lively contrast.
  • Tonka bean absolute: Warm, sweet and slightly balsamic, for a sensual depth.
  • Tobacco Absolute: Dark, smoky and rebellious, for an intense accent.
  • Leather accord: Striking and powerful, for a robust base.

Concentration:
With a perfume concentration of 15%, Papyrus Moléculaire offers an elegant and long-lasting presence that captivates the senses without overwhelming.

Experience:
Papyrus Moléculaire is a tribute to individuality and creativity. The fragrance is like an olfactory tattoo that tells stories and highlights bold personalities. Perfect for those who are looking for something special and want to stand out from the crowd through their choice of fragrance.
